sentence: This project builds engineered receptors that help T cells detect tumor antigens and metabolites in order to destroy solid tumors.
This project tests gene therapy with viral vectors in mouse models and engineered heart tissue to treat limb girdle muscular dystrophy while lowering immune responses.
This project studies genetic variants that affect the risk and severity of hidradenitis suppurativa, a skin disease.
This project tests ways to block a molecular interaction that explains why some blockers work less well at promoting transplant tolerance.
This project works on immune-based ways to monitor and treat cancer and studies how infection and inflammation lead to cancer development.
This project works to make AI systems for robotic-assisted surgery safer and easier to explain while protecting patient data.
This project builds a digital twins platform using AI and machine learning to find Alzheimer's drug targets from human genome sequencing findings.
This project studies how T cells respond to COVID-19 vaccination and infection in patients with lymphoma or chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
This project studies how a mutation in a lung protein gene disrupts lung cell function in pediatric interstitial lung disease, using a mouse model.
This project studies how cancer cells change their genome, signaling and surroundings to grow and spread, including DNA replication and repair.
This project builds a prototype x-ray CT system with a scintillator-based photon counting detector and tests it against a clinical system.
This project builds a model that predicts the computing resources needed to analyze tumor sequencing data and plans a cost- and time-saving cloud run.
This project links host genetics and the oral microbiome with health records to find genetic and microbial factors behind oral disease risk.
This project studies why neurons become senescent during aging and Alzheimer's disease, using neuronal cultures and fibroblasts from the same individuals.
This project compares cancer cell cultures, including monolayer and organoid models, from the same patient to find how best to use these models.
This project builds a computational framework to find which HIV immune escape mechanisms hold across viral diversity and how immune pressure shapes escape.
This project provides statistics and informatics support, data management and analysis for research on aging in older adults.
This project studies how methamphetamine and HIV together infect brain pericytes and affect HIV latency.
This project studies cancer risk behaviors and works to change them and to improve cancer screening and survivorship.
This project studies how a gene affects human blood vessel cells in macular degeneration and looks for genes that separate early, dry and wet forms.
